newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine feed millers plan to buy 150,000 T corn.
newsitem.headline: Philippine feed millers plan to buy 150,000 T corn.

text.p: Philippine feed millers plan to buy up to 150,000 tonnes of U.S. corn for December delivery, an industry executive involved in the negotiations told Reuters on Tuesday.
The Philippine Association of Feed Millers Inc had asked the state-controlled National Food Authority to import the corn for the group, the executive said.
The feed millers plan to post the order in October for delivery in December, he said.
"The order is in anticipation of a shortage during the lean months in the first quarter of 1997," the executive said.
The Philippines has imported 250,000 tonnes of corn for animal feed from the United States and Argentina since the start of the year.
